answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 131076 Country: Japan Title: Stool/feces and urine leaking Question: I have disease. My feces leaks also my urine leaks I had stomach operation. After wudhu it looks like my urine has leaked again. Leak of feces makes my pajama napak also urine leak makes my pajama napak. Could you tell me if my namaz in this situation will be accepted? What shall I do? Answer ID: 131076 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1104/1108/SD=2/1438) If you are not ma’zur (excused) as per the Shariah definition, then your wudhu shall break after leakage of urine drops and if the urine smears with the clothes then they shall also be impure. In such a case, it shall be mandatory for you to make fresh wudhu and clean the cloth, only then your salah shall be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
